steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: OCR J280 uses specific command words that determine the depth and type of response required

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Describe' means give an account of what happened or what something was like

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Explain' requires giving reasons or causes — show how and why something happened

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Explain the significance' demands you show both what happened and why it mattered

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What is the key difference between 'describe' and 'explain'? | Q: What must you include in a 'how far' answer? | Q: How should you approach a 'compare' question?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Describe requires an account of what happened (factual detail), while explain requires reasons why it happened (causation and significance). | A balanced argument showing both sides, supported by specific evidence, leading to a clear judgement. | Identify both similarities and differences using specific evidence, linking the comparison to the question's focus.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Circle or underline the command word before writing For 'how far' questions, plan both sides for balance Short-answer: one specific point per mark Extended answers need 3-4 developed paragraphs plus a conclusion Always use evidence from classical sources, not just general knowledge
